pairs.reason: C's Done/Now/Your-part strip, in-plan approval and ledger-ruled totals give clearer order and better money typography; A is clean but generic, with monospace invoice IDs cluttering tables.
C keeps the decision inside the plan step with a jump link and strong figures; B's decision falls to frame 2 of a long page with the plan repeated below.
A's result leads with three large money tiles and its approval is tighter; B has more character (Plex, dark sidebar) but buries its outcome figures in small stat cells.

notes: All three pass the measured contrast and target checks and show status with icon plus text. Identity stays at 3 for all three: each passes the name-swap test, though B's dark green sidebar and IBM Plex give it the most distinct character. C's red flag labels on the result screen are slightly alarming but not a flood.
